subject: Greenleaf Health activation gating & fallback plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jim Greenleaf <jim.greenleaf@greenleafhealth.com>, procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenleaf Health: activation gating & fallback ask

Team —

Quick context: Greenleaf (prospect → 6-figure ARR EAP) asked us to commit to a production pilot window with a hard go-live target of May 15. They need predictable latency (p95 <= 55ms), token-level logging for audit, and a fallback path if the dedicated lane is saturated during peak clinical batch windows.

Attached is the customer MAP and the internal ask from their SRE/Procurement teams. High-level asks from Sales/CS:
- Dedicated warm pool during business hours (M-F 07:00-19:00 PT) for pilot
- Priority routing with automatic fallback to a quantized/low-cost variant and clear throttling behavior
- Audit export scoping and temp retention bump (60 days for pilot)

Why this matters: if we can meet pilot SLAs they commit to a 12-month reserved capacity contract. We need Product/Eng alignment on feasibility and a safe rollback/fallback plan in the next 48–72 hours so I can update Jim and Procurement.

Can we get a short technical call today (30 min) and a one-page gating + rollback matrix? I attached the MAP and a suggested timeline.

Attachments: greenleaf-activation-map.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenleaf Health: activation gating & fallback ask

Marissa — thanks for the context and the MAP. I can join a call at 11:30 PT; Ben/ Jonas — can you confirm availability?

Preliminary questions / constraints we should surface before the call so Sales and the customer have clear expectations:
1) Warm pool sizing: what is the minimum GPU reservation that keeps p95 in the requested window for their expected QPS profile?
2) Fallback model fidelity: what is the expected quality delta if we route to a smaller/quantized variant? Any critical prompt patterns (HIPAA-sensitive forms) we must preserve?
3) Audit export scope: 60-day retention for pilot is doable from a storage perspective but requires config changes and a compliance sign-off.

I want a concise gating matrix that lists (a) acceptance criteria, (b) telemetry signals that trigger rollback, and (c) an automated fallback policy we can present to the customer. Ben/Jonas — can you draft a 1-pager (matrix + one-sentence risk) and drop it in the Drive link below before the call? Marissa — please confirm the peak windows & expected token volumes (hourly).

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Technical Program Management
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 12:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenleaf Health: activation gating & fallback ask

Kimberly / team —

Thanks — quick technical readout from my side after looking at the MAP and the sample traffic profile Marissa shared:
- Feasibility: We can meet p95 <= 55ms in-stable with a small dedicated pool (2x A200 equiv) + aggressive prefix caching for known form prefixes.
- Timeline: 2 workstreams in parallel: (A) runtime config + routing policy (3 days to canary), (B) audit export and retention config (2 days but requires compliance review). End-to-end staging validation estimated by May 10 if we start today.
- Fallback: automated routing to a lower-cost 8-bit quantized variant is straightforward; expected degradation on long-form summarization prompts (~5–7% BLEU-like metric drop on our test set). Suggest we keep a small sample set of critical prompts pinned to the high-fidelity model for the pilot.

Risks / gating signals:
- If the warm pool CPU/GPU utilization exceeds 85% for 10 consecutive minutes during peak windows -> automatic flow into fallback model + alert to on-call infra.
- If audit export throughput lags >30% for >15 minutes, pause new sessions and initiate manual triage.

I uploaded a short technical brief and a proposed prioritization-gating-matrix to Drive (see link). Attach: tech-impact-notes.pdf, prioritization-gating-matrix.csv

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jim Greenleaf <jim.greenleaf@greenleafhealth.com>, procurement@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenleaf Health: activation gating & fallback ask

Team / Jim —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. After reviewing Ben's notes and the matrix, Product supports an expedited EAP gating for Greenleaf with the following conditions:

1) Scope: Pilot = 6 weeks, limited to the three clinical flows listed in the MAP. No additional APIs or schema changes during pilot.
2) Canaries: Start with a 5% traffic canary on the dedicated warm pool, validate telemetry for 48 hours, then ramp to 25% for another 48 hours before full pilot traffic.
3) Fallback & pinning: Implement Ben's fallback policy + pin the 12 critical prompts (redacted) to the high-fidelity model. Quantized variant used for bursts only.
4) Audit retention: Approve 60-day pilot retention; Compliance will perform a one-time checklist review and sign-off within 48 hours.
5) Acceptance & rollback signals:
   - Auto-rollback to fallback model on sustained p95 > 75ms for 15 minutes.
   - Manual rollback if error rates exceed 3% for one hour.

Action items:
- Jonas: schedule warm-pool provisioning and create the infra playbook (INF-1298).
- Ben: validate pinned-prompt behavior and finalize the gating CSV.
- Kimberly / Marissa: confirm go/no-go checkpoints with Greenleaf and update contract milestone "Pilot Activation" to May 10 staging sign-off.

Marissa — can you confirm token/hour estimates for the three pilot flows and whether Procurement needs any additional legal wording for the rollback/fallback? Jim — appreciate if you can confirm that the 60-day retention is acceptable to Procurement.

If we all agree, Product will mark this EAP S1 and we will prioritize the infra/serving tickets accordingly. If Procurement requests changes that affect compliance, we will pause activation until sign-off.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Group PM, Product Delivery
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
